headlines: Stocktwits posters cite an October US payrolls print of +165k vs 59k expected and unemployment 4.1% (not confirmed by web search)
Poster-cited Dec Fed hike odds: 98% last week, 79% before the jobs report, 75% now (unverified)
Stocklake: fear and greed 21 (extreme fear), VIX 26.4, QQQ RSI ~27, SPY RSI ~33 as of yesterday's close
Trending premarket: DKNG -26%, ASTS, WULF +13%, OKLO +10%, HIMS +8% (reasons not confirmed)

rumors.text: Posters say the jobs data is fake because gold, oil and yields are not reacting; jobs tied to a bursting AI bubble
rumors.why: If the data were doubted broadly, the rally on good numbers would fade

rumors.text: Poster hints at war this weekend
rumors.why: Weekend geopolitical risk would encourage de-risking into the close

rumors.text: Posters say Democrats oppose AI and datacenters, a policy risk for AI names
rumors.why: Regulation talk could add pressure to an already weak AI group

rumors.text: Posters say yesterday's put buying will expire worthless and the market will be run higher
rumors.why: A crowded bearish bet can squeeze higher if put hedges unwind

plays.reason: Extreme fear, oversold QQQ, falling rate-hike odds after payrolls; crowd leans bearish, which can fuel a squeeze, but SPY has not rallied on the good data
plays.catalyst: Payrolls reaction and unwinding of put hedges

readings.whats_new: Payrolls came out at 13:30 UTC; posters say it beat (165k vs 59k, unverified) and hike odds fell. SPY is flat near 734 versus the -3.9% selloff last hour, with Stocktwits sentiment up to 44 from 34 and posts turning choppy rather than panicked. Reddit blocked and web search found no coverage of the payrolls print.
